mapper.select: /* com.heeji.picket.mapper.ShowLikesMapper.list */ SELECT SL.LIKE_ID AS likeId , SL.SHOW_ID AS showId , SL.USER_ID AS userId , SL.INSERT_DATE AS insertDate , S.TITLE AS title , S.PLACE AS place , S.POSTER_LINK AS posterLink FROM SHOW_LIKES SL LEFT JOIN SHOWS S ON SL.SHOW_ID = S.SHOW_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND SL.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY SL.LIKE_ID DESC
